The '''Master in Red''' was a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and one of the [[Five Masters]], who taught within the [[Five Masters Academy]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Martial Arts" /> Like the others Masters, the Master in Red was killed when the Training Hall was destroyed in a massive fire. The body of the Master in Red was discovered by [[Barnab Chistor]] in the Garden of Peace.
